title: Engineering electrolyte ion solvation structures for next-generation batteries - Nature Communications
html:
Ion solvation shells govern ion transport, interfacial reactions, and electrolyte stability in batteries. Here, we explore engineering ion solvation structures as a cross-scale design paradigm linking molecular coordination to device performance. This Comment explores unified design principles to enable predictive electrolyte development for fast charging, temperature resilience, and high-voltage operation.
